title: bay status --json
description: Output of `bay status --json`, status_version 2. Documented in docs/deploy-receipt.md. A new field may be added without a version bump; a removed or retyped field bumps status_version.

version.description: bay_version from version.yml in the install; null when the file is missing.

path.description: The checkout the bay command runs from.

source.description: How Bay found the fleet: the --fleet option, the BAY_FLEET variable, the fleet named in bay.toml, BAY_FLEET_NAME (a fleet under ~/.config/bay/fleets), or the working directory.

commit.description: Full SHA of the fleet repo HEAD; null outside git.

dirty.description: Uncommitted changes under the fleet root; null outside git.

box.description: inventory_hostname; null when no box could be listed.

receipt.description: The box's receipt, or null when there is none or it could not be read.

receipt.title: Deploy receipt, receipt_version 1
receipt.description: /var/lib/bay/receipts/<env>.json on the box. Written by bay_reconcile.receipt.

image.description: The image the container runs: <repo>:<commit12> when that tag resolves to it on the box, else the reference the deploy asked for.

image_ref.description: The image reference the deploy asked for. Absent in receipts written before track mode.

commit.description: The 12-character commit the running image was built from (label com.bay.commit), or null. A webhook build updates it in place.
